rows.source_ko: 재외동포청 (혁신행정담당관), 032-585-3144
rows.text_en: Overseas Koreans Agency ( Innovation Administration Division ), 032-585-3144

rows.source_ko: 제1장 총칙
rows.text_en: Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 재외동포청에 두는 보조기관ㆍ보좌기관의 직급 및 직무등급과 직급별 정원 및 직무등급별 정원, 「정부조직법」 제2조제3항 및 제5항에 따라 국장 밑에 두는 보조기관과 이에 상당하는 보좌기관의 설치 및 사무분장 등 「재외동포청 직제」에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Organization of the Overseas Koreans Agency and matters necessary for its implementation, including the ranks and job grades of auxiliary and advisory organizations established within the Agency, staffing quotas by rank and job grade, and the establishment of auxiliary organizations under a director pursuant to Article 2(3) and (5) of the Government Organization Act, as well as advisory organizations equivalent thereto.

rows.source_ko: 제2장 재외동포청
rows.text_en: Chapter 2 Overseas Koreans Agency

rows.source_ko: 제2조(차장) 차장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 외무공무원 또는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 가등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Deputy Minister) The Deputy Minister shall be appointed from among foreign service officials or general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade A.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(대변인) 대변인은 외무공무원 또는 서기관으로 보하되, 외무공무원으로 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 8등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Spokesperson) A spokesperson shall be appointed as a foreign service officer or a secretary, provided that if appointed as a foreign service officer, the job grade of the position shall be Grade 8.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(재외동포서비스지원센터장) 재외동포서비스지원센터장은 외무공무원 또는 부이사관ㆍ서기관으로 보하되, 외무공무원으로 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 9등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Head of Overseas Korean Service Support Center) The Head of the Overseas Korean Service Support Center shall be appointed as a foreign service officer or a deputy director or secretary, provided that if appointed as a foreign service officer, the job grade of the position shall be Grade 9.

rows.source_ko: 제5조(기획조정관) ① 기획조정관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원 또는 외무공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Director of Planning and Coordination) ① The Director of Planning and Coordination shall be appointed from among general civil servants or foreign service officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 기획조정관 밑에 기획재정담당관 및 혁신행정담당관을 둔다.
rows.text_en: ② Under the Director of Planning and Coordination, there shall be a Director of Planning and Finance and a Director of Innovation and Administration.

rows.source_ko: ③ 기획재정담당관은 외무공무원 또는 서기관으로 보하되, 외무공무원으로 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 8등급으로 하고, 혁신행정담당관은 서기관 또는 외무공무원으로 보하되, 외무공무원으로 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 8등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Planning and Finance Officer shall be appointed as a Foreign Service Officer or a Secretary, provided that if appointed as a Foreign Service Officer, the job grade of the position shall be Grade 8, and the Innovation Administration Officer shall be appointed as a Secretary or a Foreign Service Officer, provided that if appointed as a Foreign Service Officer, the job grade of the position shall be Grade 8.

rows.source_ko: ④ 기획재정담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정관을 보좌한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Planning and Finance Officer assists the Planning and Coordination Officer with respect to the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 청 내 각종 정책과 계획 수립의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of the formulation of various policies and plans within the agency

rows.source_ko: 2. 청 내 정책사업 및 현안ㆍ조정 과제의 발굴ㆍ전파
rows.text_en: 2. Identification and dissemination of policy projects, pending issues, and coordination tasks within the Agency

rows.source_ko: 3. 재정계획 수립 및 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the establishment and operation of financial plans

rows.source_ko: 4. 세입ㆍ세출예산 편성 및 배정, 집행의 조정 및 결산
rows.text_en: 4. Formulation and allocation of revenue and expenditure budgets, coordination of execution, and settlement of accounts

rows.source_ko: 5. 청 내 통계업무의 종합 및 조정
rows.text_en: 5. Consolidation and coordination of statistical work within the Agency

rows.source_ko: 6. 국회 및 정당과 관련된 업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 6. Overall management and coordination of affairs related to the National Assembly and political parties

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 청 내 다른 부서의 소관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other departments within the Agency

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 혁신행정담당관은 다음 사항에 관하여 기획조정관을 보좌한다. <개정 2025. 4. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Innovation Administration Officer assists the Planning and Coordination Officer with respect to the following matters. <Amended Apr. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 청 내 행정관리 업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 1. Overall management and coordination of administrative affairs within the agency

rows.source_ko: 2. 청 내 성과관리 계획 수립 및 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of internal performance management plans and overall coordination

rows.source_ko: 3. 국정과제 점검ㆍ관리 및 정부업무평가에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the inspection and management of national policy tasks and the evaluation of government performance

rows.source_ko: 4. 조직진단 및 평가를 통한 조직 및 정원 관리
rows.text_en: 4. Organization and Staffing Management through Organizational Diagnosis and Evaluation

rows.source_ko: 5. 청 내 규제개혁 및 정부혁신 관련 업무 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 5. Overall management and coordination of tasks related to regulatory reform and government innovation within the Agency

rows.source_ko: 6. 소관 법제업무의 총괄 및 법령 질의ㆍ회신 관련 업무
rows.text_en: 6. Overall management of legislative affairs under one's jurisdiction and duties related to inquiries and responses to laws and regulations

rows.source_ko: 7. 행정심판 및 소송사무의 총괄
rows.text_en: 7. Overall management of administrative appeals and litigation affairs

rows.source_ko: 8. 국민ㆍ자체 제안제도 운영 및 민원사무 대응
rows.text_en: 8. Operation of Public and Internal Suggestion Systems and Response to Civil Complaints

rows.source_ko: 9. 재외동포청과 산하단체에 대한 감사
rows.text_en: 9. Audit of the Overseas Koreans Agency and its affiliated organizations

rows.source_ko: 9의2. 청 소관 비영리법인 및 비영리민간단체에 관한 업무의 총괄ㆍ조정
rows.text_en: 9-2. Overall management and coordination of affairs concerning non-profit corporations and private non-profit organizations under the jurisdiction of the Agency

rows.source_ko: 10. 진정ㆍ비위사항의 조사ㆍ처리
rows.text_en: 10. Investigation and Handling of Complaints and Misconduct

rows.source_ko: 11. 공직자 재산등록ㆍ심사, 선물신고 및 퇴직공직자 취업제한에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 11. Matters concerning the registration and review of public officials' assets, reporting of gifts, and employment restrictions for retired public officials

rows.source_ko: 12. 공직기강의 확립 및 부패방지 대책 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 12. Matters concerning the establishment of public service discipline and anti-corruption measures, etc.

rows.source_ko: 제6조(운영지원과) 운영지원과장은 서기관 또는 외무공무원 보하되, 외무공무원으로 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 8등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Operations Support Division) The Head of the Operations Support Division shall be appointed from among senior officials or foreign service officers; provided that if appointed from among foreign service officers, the job grade of the position shall be Grade 8.

rows.source_ko: 제7조(재외동포정책국) ① 재외동포정책국장은 고위공무원단에 속하는 외무공무원 또는 일반직공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Overseas Koreans Policy Bureau) ① The Director of the Overseas Koreans Policy Bureau shall be appointed from among foreign service officials or general civil servants belonging to the Senior Civil Service, and the job grade of the position shall be Grade B.

rows.source_ko: ② 재외동포정책국에 재외동포정책과ㆍ동포지원제도과ㆍ미주유럽동포과 및 아주러시아동포과를 둔다.
rows.text_en: ② The Overseas Koreans Policy Bureau shall have the Overseas Koreans Policy Division, the Overseas Koreans Support System Division, the Overseas Koreans in the Americas and Europe Division, and the Overseas Koreans in Russia Division.

rows.source_ko: ③ 재외동포정책과장은 외무공무원이나 부이사관 또는 서기관으로 보하되, 외무공무원으로 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 9등급으로 하고, 동포지원제도과장ㆍ미주유럽동포과장 및 아주러시아동포과장은 외무공무원 또는 서기관으로 보하되, 외무공무원으로 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 각각 8등급으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Head of the Overseas Korean Policy Division shall be appointed as a foreign service officer, deputy director, or secretary, provided that if appointed as a foreign service officer, the job grade of the position shall be Grade 9, and the Heads of the Overseas Korean Support System Division, the Head of the Overseas Koreans in Americas and Europe Division, and the Head of the Overseas Koreans in Russia Division shall be appointed as foreign service officers or secretaries, provided that if appointed as foreign service officers, the job grade of the position shall be Grade 8.

rows.source_ko: ④ 재외동포정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 4. 1.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Head of the Overseas Koreans Policy Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Apr. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 재외동포정책의 수립ㆍ시행 및 소관 재외동포 관련 법령의 운영
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of policies regarding overseas Koreans and operation of relevant laws concerning overseas Koreans

rows.source_ko: 2. 재외동포 관련 소관 제도 개선ㆍ연구
rows.text_en: 2. Improvement and Research on Systems Related to Overseas Koreans

rows.source_ko: 2의2. 거주국별 재외동포정책 연구 총괄
rows.text_en: 2-2. Overview of Research on Overseas Korean Policies by Country of Residence

rows.source_ko: 3. 재외동포정책 실무위원회 운영 등 관계기관ㆍ전문가와의 협조
rows.text_en: 3. Cooperation with relevant agencies and experts, including the operation of the Working Committee on Overseas Korean Policy

rows.source_ko: 4. 재외동포의 포상 및 보훈에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning awards and veterans' affairs for overseas Koreans

rows.source_ko: 4의2. 재외동포의 현황 파악과 실태조사에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4-2. Matters concerning the identification of the current status and fact-finding survey of overseas Koreans

rows.source_ko: 4의3. 재외동포 데이터베이스 및 통계에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4-3. Matters concerning the database and statistics of overseas Koreans

rows.source_ko: 5. 재외국민 선거 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning support for overseas citizens' voting

rows.source_ko: 6. 국외 소재 한인 유산의 관리에 관한 관계기관과의 협조
rows.text_en: 6. Cooperation with relevant agencies regarding the management of Korean heritage located overseas

rows.source_ko: 7. 재외동포에 대한 사회적 인식 개선을 위한 교육ㆍ홍보
rows.text_en: 7. Education and publicity to improve social perception of overseas Koreans

rows.source_ko: 8. 그 밖에 국 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 8. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other domestic divisions

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 동포지원제도과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Head of the Compatriot Support System Division is responsible for the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. 재외동포 지원ㆍ서비스 정책의 이행 및 제도 개선에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the implementation of policies for support and services to overseas Koreans and institutional improvements

rows.source_ko: 2. 워킹홀리데이 프로그램의 이행에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the implementation of the Working Holiday Program

rows.source_ko: 3. 영사 관계 각종 문서의 공증ㆍ확인 및 인증에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the notarization, verification, and authentication of various consular documents

rows.source_ko: 4. 재외국민의 국적 및 가족관계등록 관련 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the nationality and family relationship registration of overseas Koreans

rows.source_ko: 5. 재외국민 등록에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the registration of overseas nationals

rows.source_ko: 6. 해외 이주에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning overseas relocation
7. Deleted <May 28, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 미주유럽동포과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 4. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Americas and Europe Compatriots Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Apr. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 미주ㆍ유럽 지역 재외동포정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and Implementation of Policies for Overseas Koreans in the Americas and Europe

rows.source_ko: 2. 미주ㆍ유럽 지역 재외동포 관련 동향 파악 및 현안 대응
rows.text_en: 2. Monitoring trends and responding to current issues regarding overseas Koreans in the Americas and Europe

rows.source_ko: 3. 미주ㆍ유럽 지역 재외동포 대상 행사의 개최 지원
rows.text_en: 3. Support for hosting events for overseas Koreans in the Americas and Europe

rows.source_ko: 4. 파독 광부ㆍ간호사ㆍ간호조무사 지원에 관한 관계부처와의 업무 협조
rows.text_en: 4. Business cooperation with relevant ministries regarding support for Korean miners, nurses, and nursing assistants dispatched to Germany
5. Deleted <March 26, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 6. 대통령ㆍ국무총리의 해외 방문 관련 재외동포 대상 행사 개최에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the holding of events for overseas Koreans in relation to the overseas visits of the President and the Prime Minister
7. Deleted <April 1, 2025>
8. Deleted <April 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 아주러시아동포과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다 <개정 2025. 4. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Head of the Division on Compatriots in Russia shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Apr. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 아주ㆍ러시아ㆍ독립국가연합(CIS)ㆍ아프리카ㆍ중동 지역 재외동포정책의 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of policies for overseas Koreans in Asia, Russia, the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS), Africa, and the Middle East

rows.source_ko: 2. 아주ㆍ러시아ㆍ독립국가연합(CIS)ㆍ아프리카ㆍ중동 지역 재외동포 관련 동향 파악 및 현안 대응
rows.text_en: 2. Monitoring trends and responding to current issues regarding overseas Koreans in Asia, Russia, the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS), Africa, and the Middle East

rows.source_ko: 3. 아주ㆍ러시아ㆍ독립국가연합(CIS)ㆍ아프리카ㆍ중동 지역 재외동포 대상 행사의 개최 지원
rows.text_en: 3. Support for hosting events for overseas Koreans in Asia, Russia, the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS), Africa, and the Middle East

rows.source_ko: 4. 사할린동포 영주귀국 및 국내정착 사업 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning support for the permanent repatriation and domestic settlement of Sakhalin Koreans

rows.source_ko: 5. 고려인동포 권익신장 지원사업에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning support projects for the enhancement of rights and interests of Koryo-jin compatriots

rows.source_ko: 5의2. 해외위난상황 관련 재외동포 지원 정책에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5-2. Matters concerning policies for supporting overseas Koreans in relation to overseas crisis situations

rows.source_ko: 6. 민주평화통일자문회의와의 업무 협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning business cooperation with the National Advisory Council on Peaceful Unification

rows.source_ko: 제8조(교류협력국) ① 교류협력국에 재외동포협력총괄과ㆍ동포교육문화지원과ㆍ차세대동포정책과ㆍ동포경제지원과ㆍ동포인재육성과ㆍ차세대동포연수과ㆍ동포유산보존과를 둔다. <신설 2026. 7. 14.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Exchange and Cooperation Bureau) ① The Exchange and Cooperation Bureau shall be established with the General Affairs Division for Overseas Koreans Cooperation, the Division for Support for Overseas Koreans Education and Culture, the Division for Policy on Next-Generation Overseas Koreans, the Division for Support for Overseas Koreans Economy, the Division for Fostering Overseas Korean Talent, the Division for Training Next-Generation Overseas Koreans, and the Division for Preserving Overseas Korean Heritage. <Newly added July 14, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 교류협력국장 및 동포역량지원관은 고위공무원단에 속하는 일반직공무원 또는 외무공무원으로 보하되, 그 직위의 직무등급은 나등급으로 한다. <개정 2026. 7. 14.>
rows.text_en: ② The Director General for Exchange and Cooperation and the Officer for Supporting Overseas Koreans’ Capacity shall be appointed as general civil servants or foreign service officers belonging to the Senior Civil Service, provided that the job grade of such positions is Grade B. <Amended July 14, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ③ 동포역량지원관은 「재외동포청 직제」 제10조제3항제10호부터 제13호까지의 사항에 관하여 교류협력국장을 보좌한다. <신설 2026. 7. 14.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Officer for Supporting Overseas Koreans’ Capacity shall assist the Director-General of the Exchange and Cooperation Bureau with respect to matters under Article 10, Paragraph 3, Subparagraphs 10 through 13 of the Organizational Structure of the Agency for Overseas Koreans. <Newly added July 14, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ④ 재외동포협력총괄과장은 외무공무원 또는 서기관으로 보하되, 외무공무원으로 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 8등급으로 하고, 동포교육문화지원과장ㆍ차세대동포정책과장ㆍ동포경제지원과장ㆍ동포인재육성과장ㆍ차세대동포연수과장ㆍ동포유산보존과장은 서기관 또는 외무공무원으로 보하되, 외무공무원으로 보하는 경우 그 직위의 직무등급은 각각 8등급으로 한다. <개정 2025. 4. 1., 2026. 7. 14.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Director of the Overseas Korean Cooperation Division shall be appointed as a Foreign Service Officer or a Secretary; provided that if appointed as a Foreign Service Officer, the job grade of the position shall be Grade 8. The Directors of the Overseas Korean Education and Culture Support Division, the Next Generation Overseas Korean Policy Division, the Overseas Korean Economy Support Division, the Overseas Korean Talent Development Division, the Next Generation Overseas Korean Training Division, and the Overseas Korean Heritage Preservation Division shall be appointed as Secretarys or Foreign Service Officers; provided that if appointed as Foreign Service Officers, the job grade of the position shall be Grade 8 for each. <Amended Apr. 1, 2025; Jul. 14, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 재외동포협력총괄과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 4. 1., 2026. 7. 14.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Director General of the Overseas Koreans Cooperation Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Apr. 1, 2025; Jul. 14, 2026>

rows.text_en: 1. Overall management of exchange and support projects for overseas Koreans and overseas Korean organizations

rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the deliberation of exchange and support projects for overseas Koreans and overseas Korean organizations

rows.text_en: 3. Discovery of cooperative projects with overseas Koreans and overseas Korean organizations

rows.source_ko: 4. 재외동포단체 네트워크 구축 및 관리

rows.text_en: 4-3. Matters concerning databases and statistics of overseas Korean organizations

rows.source_ko: 5. 재외동포 관련 기념사업의 시행 총괄
rows.text_en: 5. Overall management of commemorative projects related to overseas Koreans

rows.source_ko: 6. 세계한인의 날 기념식 개최에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the hosting of the World Korean Day commemorative ceremony

rows.source_ko: 7. 재외동포 유관기관 초청행사 개최에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning the holding of invitation events for organizations related to overseas Koreans

rows.source_ko: 8. 유망 재외동포와의 네트워크 구축 및 관리
rows.text_en: 8. Establishment and Management of Networks with Promising Overseas Koreans

rows.source_ko: 9. 재외동포 역량 강화에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning the capacity building of overseas Koreans

rows.source_ko: 10. 그 밖의 국 내 다른 과의 주관에 속하지 않는 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Other matters not under the jurisdiction of other domestic divisions

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 동포교육문화지원과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2026. 7. 14.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Head of the Overseas Korean Education and Culture Support Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended July 14, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 재외교육기관의 지원에 관한 재외동포청 소관 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters under the jurisdiction of the Overseas Koreans Agency regarding support for overseas educational institutions

rows.source_ko: 2. 한글학교 운영 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning support for the operation of Korean language schools

rows.source_ko: 3. 한글학교 교사ㆍ재외동포 한국어 교원 초청 연수 기획 및 시행 총괄
rows.text_en: 3. Overall planning and implementation of invitational training for Korean language school teachers and overseas Korean language instructors

rows.source_ko: 4. 재외동포 문화 및 언론 단체 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning support for overseas Korean cultural and media organizations

rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the establishment of a network of overseas Korean cultural and artistic figures and journalists

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 차세대동포정책과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 4. 1., 2026. 7. 14.>

rows.source_ko: 1. 차세대 재외동포 협력사업의 기획 및 조정
rows.text_en: 1. Planning and coordination of cooperation projects for the next generation of overseas Koreans
2. Deleted <July 14, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 3. 차세대 재외동포 대상 행사 개최에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the hosting of events for the next generation of overseas Koreans

rows.source_ko: 4. 차세대 재외동포단체 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning support for next-generation overseas Korean organizations

rows.source_ko: 5. 차세대 재외동포 및 해외 한인입양인 네트워크 구축 및 교류협력에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the establishment of networks and exchange cooperation for the next generation of overseas Koreans and overseas Korean adoptees

rows.source_ko: 6. 해외 한인입양인 권익신장 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning support for the enhancement of rights and interests of overseas Korean adoptees

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 동포경제지원과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <개정 2025. 4. 1., 2026. 7. 14.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Head of the Overseas Korean Economic Support Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Amended Apr. 1, 2025; Jul. 14, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 국내 경제인과 재외동포 경제인 간 인적교류사업에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning personnel exchange programs between domestic businesspeople and overseas Korean businesspeople

rows.source_ko: 2. 재외동포 경제인 네트워크 구축 및 유관 기관과의 업무 협조
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of a network of overseas Korean businesspeople and business cooperation with relevant organizations

rows.source_ko: 3. 재외동포 경제단체 협력 업무 발굴에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the identification of cooperative activities with overseas Korean economic organizations

rows.source_ko: 4. 재외동포 경제인 대상 행사 개최에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the hosting of events for overseas Korean businesspeople

rows.source_ko: 5. 한상(韓商) 네트워크 활성화 사업
rows.text_en: 5. Project to Revitalize the Hansang Network

rows.source_ko: 6. 한상기업 청년채용 인턴십에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the Youth Recruitment Internship at Overseas Korean Businesses

rows.source_ko: 7. 재외동포 기업ㆍ경제인의 국내 진출 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning support for the domestic entry of overseas Korean companies and businesspeople

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 동포인재육성과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2026. 7. 14.>
rows.text_en: ⑨ The Director of the Overseas Talent Development Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly established July 14, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 재외동포 인재육성 정책 수립ㆍ시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of policies for fostering talent among overseas Koreans

rows.source_ko: 2. 재외동포 인재육성을 위한 학업 및 취업 지원에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning support for academic studies and employment for the cultivation of overseas Korean talent

rows.source_ko: 3. 재외동포 모국ㆍ현지 장학사업의 기획ㆍ조정 및 집행에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the planning, coordination, and execution of scholarship programs for overseas Koreans in the homeland and abroad

rows.source_ko: 4. 재외동포 장학생 통합 데이터베이스 및 네트워크 구축 등 사후관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning post-management, such as the establishment of an integrated database and network for overseas Korean scholarship recipients

rows.source_ko: ⑩ 차세대동포연수과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2026. 7. 14.>
rows.text_en: 10. The Head of the Next Generation Overseas Korean Training Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly established July 14, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 차세대동포 초청연수 사업 등의 기획 및 운영
rows.text_en: 1. Planning and operation of programs such as the invitation training program for the next generation of overseas Koreans

rows.source_ko: 2. 차세대동포 초청연수 교육과정 개발 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the development of educational curricula, etc. for the invitation training of the next generation of overseas Koreans

rows.source_ko: 3. 차세대동포 초청연수 참가자 데이터베이스 및 네트워크 구축 등 사후관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning follow-up management, such as the establishment of a database and network for participants in the next-generation overseas Korean invitation training program

rows.source_ko: 4. 차세대동포 초청연수 성과관리 및 안전관리 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning performance management and safety management, etc. of the invitation training for next-generation overseas Koreans

rows.source_ko: 5. 차세대동포 초청연수 홍보 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the promotion, etc. of the invitation training for the next generation of overseas Koreans

rows.source_ko: 6. 초청연수 관련 중앙행정기관, 지방자치단체 및 시ㆍ도 교육청 등 관계 기관과의 협조
rows.text_en: 6. Cooperation with relevant organizations, such as central administrative agencies, local governments, and city/provincial offices of education, regarding invitation training

rows.source_ko: ⑪ 동포유산보존과장은 다음 사항을 분장한다. <신설 2026. 7. 14.>
rows.text_en: 11. The Head of the Overseas Korean Heritage Preservation Division shall be responsible for the following matters. <Newly added July 14, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 재외동포 관련 기록물 및 유산 등의 수집ㆍ관리ㆍ보존 정책 수립 및 시행
rows.text_en: 1. Establishment and implementation of policies for the collection, management, and preservation of records and heritage related to overseas Koreans

rows.source_ko: 2. 재외동포 관련 디지털 아카이브 구축
rows.text_en: 2. Establishment of a digital archive related to overseas Koreans

rows.source_ko: 3. 재외동포 관련 전시 기획 및 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the planning and operation of exhibitions related to overseas Koreans

rows.source_ko: 4. 재외동포 교육문화센터 건립 및 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the establishment and operation of the Overseas Korean Education and Culture Center

rows.source_ko: 5. 재외동포 교육문화센터 프로그램 개발 및 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the development and operation of programs for the Overseas Korean Education and Culture Center

rows.source_ko: 6. 고려인역사박물관 건립 및 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning the establishment and operation of the Koryoin History Museum

rows.source_ko: 제3장 공무원의 정원
rows.text_en: Chapter 3 Staffing of Public Officials

rows.source_ko: 제9조(재외동포청에 두는 공무원의 정원) ① 재외동포청에 두는 공무원의 직급별 정원은 별표 1과 같다. <개정 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Standard Quota of Public Officials in the Overseas Koreans Agency) ① The standard quota of public officials by rank in the Overseas Koreans Agencyis as set forth in Attached Table 1. <Amended Aug. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ② 재외동포청에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 10명(7등급ㆍ8등급 또는 4급 3명, 5등급ㆍ6등급 또는 5급 2명, 3등급ㆍ4등급 또는 6급ㆍ7급 4명, 9급 1명)은 임기제공무원으로 임용할 수 있다. <신설 2023. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② Of the authorized number of public officials of the Overseas Koreans Agency, ten positions (three positions at Grade 7, Grade 8, or Grade 4; two positions at Grade 5 or Grade 6; four positions at Grade 3, Grade 4, or Grade 6 or 7; and one position at Grade 9) may be filled by fixed-term public officials.

rows.source_ko: 제10조(시간선택제채용공무원 정원의 운영) 「행정기관의 조직과 정원에 관한 통칙」 제24조제3항 및 「공무원임용령」 제3조의3제1항에 따라 재외동포청에 두는 시간선택제채용공무원 정원은 재외동포청에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 일부를 활용하여 운영할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Operation of Quotas for Part-time Public Officials) Pursuant to Article 24 , Paragraph 3 of the “General Rules on the Organization and Quotas of Administrative Agencies” and Article 3-3, Paragraph 1 of the “Public Officials Appointment Decree,” the quota for part-time public officials to be established in the Overseas Koreans Agency may be operated by utilizing a portion of the quota for public officials to be established in the Overseas Koreans Agency.

rows.source_ko: 제4장 평가대상 조직
rows.text_en: Chapter 4 Organizations Subject to Evaluation

rows.source_ko: 제11조(평가대상 조직) 「재외동포청 직제」 제14조제2항에 따른 평가대상 조직의 구체적인 사항은 별표 2와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Organizations Subject to Evaluation) Specific details regarding organizations subject to evaluation pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 2 of the “Organizational Structure of the Overseas Koreans Agency” are as set forth in Attached Table 2 .

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 2023년 6월 5일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on June 5, 2023.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(다른 법령의 개정) ① 공문서에 대한 아포스티유 및 본부영사확인서 발급에 관한 규정 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① The Enforcement Rules of the Regulations on the Issuance of Apostilles and Headquarters Consular Confirmations for Public Documents are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제2조 각 호 외의 부분 본문, 제3조, 제4조제1항ㆍ제2항ㆍ제3항 및 제5조제1항 중 “외교부장관”을 각각 “재외동포청장”으로 한다.

rows.text_en: In Form No. 1 of the Attached Appendix, “Minister of Foreign Affairs” shall be changed to “Administrator of the Overseas Koreans Agency.”

rows.text_en: In the attached forms, “Minister of Foreign Affairs” shall be changed to “Administrator of Overseas Koreans.”

rows.text_en: In Forms No. 3 and No. 4, “Minister of Foreign Affairs” shall be changed to “Administrator of Overseas Koreans”.

rows.text_en: ④ Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Overseas Emigration Act is amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제3조, 제5조제2항 각 호 외의 부분 본문, 제6조, 제7조제1항, 제8조제2항ㆍ제4항, 제9호제1항ㆍ제2항ㆍ제3항, 제10조, 제12조제2항, 제13조제2항 및 제14조 각 호 외의 부분 중 “외교부장관”을 각각 “재외동포청장”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 3, the main text of Article 5, paragraph 2 excluding the subparagraphs, Article 6, Article 7, paragraph 1, Article 8, paragraphs 2 and 4, Subparagraph 9, paragraphs 1, 2, and 3, Article 10, Article 12, paragraph 2, Article 13, paragraph 2, and Article 14 excluding the subparagraphs, “Minister of Foreign Affairs” shall be changed to “Administrator of the Overseas Koreans Agency”.

rows.source_ko: 별표 Ⅱ. 제9호 각 목 외의 부분 중 “외교부장관”을 “재외동포청장”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the part other than the items of Item 9 of Annex II, “Minister of Foreign Affairs” shall be changed to “Administrator of Overseas Koreans.”

rows.source_ko: 별지 제1호서식, 별지 제6호서식, 별지 제8호서식, 별지 제9호서식, 별지 제10호서식, 별지 제11호서식, 별지 제12호서식, 별지 제13호서식, 별지 제14호서식 및 별지 제16호서식 중 “외교부장관”을 각각 “재외동포청장”으로 하고, “(외교부)”를 각각 “(재외동포청)”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Forms No. 1, No. 6, No. 8, No. 9, No. 10, No. 11, No. 12, No. 13, No. 14, and No. 16, “Minister of Foreign Affairs” shall be replaced with “Administrator of Overseas Koreans”, and “(Ministry of Foreign Affairs)” shall be replaced with “(Overseas Koreans Agency)”.

rows.source_ko: 별지 제2호서식, 별지 제7호서식, 별지 제15호서식 및 별지 제17호서식 중 “외교부장관”을 각각 “재외동포청장”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Forms No. 2, No. 7, No. 15, and No. 17, “Minister of Foreign Affairs” shall be changed to “Administrator of Overseas Koreans”.

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 외교부령 제162호 재외동포청 직제 시행규칙 일부개정령 별표 1의 개정규정은 2026년 10월 1일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the amended provisions of Annex 1 of the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rule of the Organizational Structure of the Overseas Koreans Agency, Ministry of Foreign Affairs Decree No. 162, shall enter into force on October 1, 2026.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(재외동포청 공무원 정원에 관한 특례) 재외동포청에 두는 공무원의 정원에 관하여는 외교부령 제162호 재외동포청 직제 시행규칙 일부개정령 별표 1의 개정규정에도 불구하고 2026년 9월 30일까지는 별표 1의2의 개정규정을 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Special provisions regarding the number of  public officials in the Overseas Koreans Agency) Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Annex 1 of the Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules of the Organizational Structure of the Overseas Koreans Agency, Ministry of Foreign Affairs Decree No. 162, the amended provisions of Annex 1-2 shall apply to the number of public officials in the Overseas Koreans Agency until September 30, 2026.
